name: 调教控制台新版
htmlTemplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=300,initial-scale=1">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:-apple-system,"PingFang SC",sans-serif;background:transparent}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0}

.dv{position:relative;width:280px;height:580px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#2a0a1a 0%,#1a0510 40%,#0a0205 100%);border-radius:36px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #4a0a2a,0 0 0 5px #1a0510,0 0 40px rgba(255,30,100,0.25),0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid rgba(255,100,150,0.15)}

/* 背景粒子 */
.bg-particles{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.bg-particle{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,100,150,.6);border-radius:50%;animation:floatUp linear infinite;box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(255,100,150,.8)}
@keyframes floatUp{0%{transform:translateY(600px) translateX(0);opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}90%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-20px) translateX(20px);opacity:0}}

/* 年龄验证 */
.age-gate{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(10,2,5,0.98);z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;text-align:center;border-radius:36px}
.age-gate.hidden{display:none}
.age-icon{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:10px;animation:pulse 2s infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,30,80,.6))}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.1)}}
.age-title{color:#ff3366;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,51,102,0.6);letter-spacing:2px}
.age-warn{color:#ff8899;font-size:9px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:14px;max-width:220px}
.age-warn b{color:#ff3366}
.age-btns{display:flex;gap:8px}
.age-btn{padding:8px 22px;border-radius:18px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:1px}
.age-btn.yes{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(255,23,85,0.5)}
.age-btn.yes:active{transform:scale(0.95)}
.age-btn.no{background:transparent;border:1px solid #555;color:#777}
.age-sub{color:#553344;font-size:7px;margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:1px}

.dv-content{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative;z-index:1}
.dv-content.show{display:flex}

/* 状态栏 */
.sb{height:30px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;font-size:9px;color:#ff99bb;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:600}
.sb .is{position:absolute;top:3px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:65px;height:20px;background:#000;border-radius:10px}

/* 顶部头部 */
.top{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(40,5,20,0.9),rgba(60,10,30,0.85),rgba(40,5,20,0.9));border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;position:relative}
.top-av{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#aa0033);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,23,85,0.5);animation:avatarPulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes avatarPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,23,85,0.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,23,85,0.8)}}
.top-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.top-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.top-sub{color:#ff6688;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}
.top-vip{font-size:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ff9500);color:#3d2700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;animation:vipShine 2s infinite}
@keyframes vipShine{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,215,0,.9)}}

/* 沉沦度状态条 */
.status-bar{padding:6px 10px;background:rgba(20,5,10,0.6);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08);flex-shrink:0}
.status-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.status-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.status-lb{font-size:7px;color:#aa6677;letter-spacing:1px;width:36px;flex-shrink:0}
.status-prog{flex:1;height:6px;background:rgba(255,80,120,0.1);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.status-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .5s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.status-fill::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.4),transparent);animation:statusShine 2s infinite}
@keyframes statusShine{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
.status-fill.lust{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff3366,#ff6699)}
.status-fill.obey{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9333ea,#c084fc)}
.status-fill.shame{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ec4899,#f9a8d4)}
.status-num{font-size:7px;color:#ff99bb;font-weight:700;min-width:24px;text-align:right}

/* 搜索 */
.search{padding:5px 8px;background:rgba(20,5,10,0.5)}
.search input{width:100%;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08);color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.search input:focus{border-color:rgba(255,80,120,0.4);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,30,80,0.2)}
.search input::placeholder{color:#553344}

/* 分类导航 */
.nav{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:5px 6px;flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto;background:rgba(20,5,10,0.4);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.05)}
.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav label{flex-shrink:0;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:8px;color:#996677;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08);white-space:nowrap;transition:all .15s}
.nav label.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.25),rgba(255,80,120,0.2));color:#ff99bb;border-color:rgba(255,80,120,0.4);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,30,80,0.3)}

/* 页面容器 */
.pgs{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.pg{display:none;flex-direction:column;flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:absolute;inset:0}
.pg.on{display:flex}
.scr{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:6px 8px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.scr::-webkit-scrollbar{width:2px}
.scr::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:2px}

/* 首页 - 等级展示 */
.level-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(60,10,30,0.6),rgba(40,5,20,0.4));border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.25);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.level-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:80px;height:80px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,215,0,.15),transparent);pointer-events:none}
.level-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.level-badge{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ff9500);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}
.level-info{flex:1}
.level-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.level-st{color:#aa6677;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}
.level-cp{font-size:9px;color:#ffd700;font-weight:700}
.level-prog{height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.level-prog-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ff6b6b);transition:width .5s}

/* 签到 / 推荐 / 抽卡 三连排 */
.action-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}
.action-card{padding:8px 4px;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);transition:all .15s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.action-card:active{transform:scale(0.95)}
.action-card.signin{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,180,0,0.15),rgba(255,100,0,0.1))}
.action-card.signin.done{opacity:0.6}
.action-card.recommend{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.15),rgba(255,80,120,0.1))}
.action-card.draw{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(155,89,182,0.15),rgba(125,60,160,0.1))}
.action-ic{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:2px;display:block}
.action-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:8px;font-weight:600}
.action-st{color:#aa6677;font-size:6px;margin-top:1px}

/* 今日推荐 */
.recommend-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.12),rgba(60,10,30,0.6));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.recommend-card:active{transform:scale(0.98)}
.recommend-tag{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;font-size:7px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;animation:tagGlow 2s infinite}
@keyframes tagGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,23,85,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,23,85,.9)}}
.recommend-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.recommend-ic{font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0}
.recommend-info{flex:1}
.recommend-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
.recommend-ds{color:#aa6677;font-size:7px;line-height:1.3}

/* 场景选择器 */
.scene-wrap{margin-bottom:8px}
.scene-tt{color:#996677;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;padding-left:2px}
.scene-list{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:2px}
.scene-list::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.scene-item{flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);font-size:8px;color:#aa7788;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.scene-item.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,30,80,0.4)}

/* 分类网格 */
.section-tt{color:#ff99bb;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;margin:4px 2px 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.section-tt::before{content:'';width:3px;height:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-radius:2px}

.cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}
.cat-cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.06),rgba(60,10,30,0.3));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.12);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:all .15s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cat-cd:active{transform:scale(0.96);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,30,80,0.3)}
.cat-cd::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0%,rgba(255,80,120,0.05) 50%,transparent 100%);pointer-events:none}
.cat-ic{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:3px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.3))}
.cat-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:600}
.cat-cnt{color:#774455;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}

/* 玩法卡片 */
.cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.04),rgba(60,10,30,0.2));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:5px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.cd:active{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08)}
.cd-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 8px 5px}
.cd-ic{font-size:16px;width:22px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.4))}
.cd-inf{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cd-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}
.cd-lvl{font-size:6px}
.cd-ds{color:#996677;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cd-tg{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-top:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-tg span{font-size:5px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.1);color:#aa6677;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.cd-rare{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;font-size:6px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}

.cd-bd{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows 0.25s ease;border-top:1px solid transparent}
.cd-bd.on{grid-template-rows:1fr;border-top-color:rgba(255,80,120,0.08)}
.cd-bd-inner{overflow:hidden}
.cd-bd-content{padding:6px 8px}
.cd-tx{color:#ffddee;font-size:7px;line-height:1.5;padding:5px 6px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.04);border-radius:5px;border-left:2px solid rgba(255,30,80,0.25);margin-bottom:4px;max-height:90px;overflow-y:auto}
.cd-tx b{color:#ff99bb}
.cd-bts{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cd-btn{flex:1;min-width:45%;padding:5px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08);color:#ff99bb;font-size:7px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;text-align:center;font-weight:600;transition:all .15s}
.cd-btn:active{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.2);transform:scale(0.96)}
.cd-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border:none}
.cd-btn.dn{background:rgba(100,200,100,0.15);border-color:rgba(100,200,100,0.3);color:#88dd88;pointer-events:none}

.variant-wrap{margin:4px 0}
.variant-tt{color:#996677;font-size:6px;margin-bottom:2px}
.variant-opts{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.variant-opt{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.12);color:#997788;font-size:6px;cursor:pointer}
.variant-opt.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}

/* 工具页 */
.tool-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.tool-cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.08),rgba(60,10,30,0.3));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 8px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tool-cd:active{transform:scale(0.96)}
.tool-cd::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-20px;right:-20px;width:60px;height:60px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,30,80,0.15),transparent);border-radius:50%}
.tool-ic{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:4px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.tool-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;position:relative;z-index:1}
.tool-ds{color:#774455;font-size:6px;margin-top:2px;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* 称呼快捷池 */
.quick-list{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
.quick-item{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);color:#ff99bb;font-size:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;transition:all .15s}
.quick-item:active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(0.95)}

/* 任务卡片 */
.task-cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(60,10,30,0.5),rgba(40,5,20,0.3));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.task-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.task-ic{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0}
.task-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.task-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:9px;font-weight:600}
.task-ds{color:#aa6677;font-size:7px;margin-top:1px}
.task-btn{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border:none;color:#fff;font-size:7px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
.task-btn.done{background:rgba(100,200,100,0.2);color:#88dd88;pointer-events:none}

/* 详情页 */
.detail-page{padding:6px}
.detail-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:#ff99bb;font-size:8px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:6px;padding:3px 0}
.detail-hd{text-align:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);margin-bottom:8px;position:relative}
.detail-ic{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,30,80,0.5))}
.detail-nm{color:#ffccdd;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.detail-lvl{color:#ff6688;font-size:9px;margin-top:2px}
.detail-ds{color:#996677;font-size:8px;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.4}
.detail-sec{margin-bottom:8px}
.detail-sec-tt{color:#ff99bb;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;letter-spacing:1px}
.detail-sec-tt::before{content:'';width:2px;height:9px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);border-radius:1px}
.detail-tx{color:#ffddee;font-size:8px;line-height:1.6;padding:7px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.04);border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.detail-bts{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.detail-btn{flex:1;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.detail-btn:active{transform:scale(0.96)}
.detail-btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,30,80,0.3)}
.detail-btn.secondary{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2);color:#ff99bb}

.reviews{margin-top:6px}
.review-item{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.08);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;margin-bottom:3px}
.review-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:3px}
.review-user{color:#ff99bb;font-size:7px;font-weight:600}
.review-stars{font-size:7px}
.review-txt{color:#bb99aa;font-size:7px;line-height:1.4}

/* 自定义 */
.custom-form{padding:6px}
.custom-tt{color:#ffccdd;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:1px}
.form-group{margin-bottom:6px}
.form-label{color:#ff99bb;font-size:7px;margin-bottom:2px;display:block;font-weight:600}
.form-input{width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);color:#ffccdd;font-size:8px;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.form-textarea{min-height:55px;resize:none}
.form-row{display:flex;gap:5px}
.form-row .form-group{flex:1}
.form-select{width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.15);background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);color:#ffccdd;font-size:8px;outline:none;font-family:inherit}
.custom-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.custom-btn{flex:1;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.custom-btn.save{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff}
.custom-btn.cancel{background:rgba(255,30,80,0.1);color:#ff99bb;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.2)}

.fav-empty{text-align:center;padding:30px 0;color:#553344;font-size:9px}
.fav-empty-ic{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:8px;opacity:0.5}

/* 特效 */
.fx-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:50;overflow:hidden;border-radius:36px}
.fx-particle{position:absolute;font-size:18px;animation:particleFade 1.3s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes particleFade{0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-70px) scale(0.4) rotate(180deg)}}

/* 底部 */
.bar{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:5px 0 2px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,5,10,0.95),rgba(10,2,5,0.98));position:relative;z-index:2}
.bar label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;color:#774455;font-size:7px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:8px;transition:all .15s}
.bar label .ic{font-size:14px;filter:opacity(.6)}
.bar label.on{color:#ff99bb}
.bar label.on .ic{filter:opacity(1) drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,30,80,0.6))}

.toast{position:absolute;bottom:55px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:9px;opacity:0;transition:all 0.3s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,30,80,0.4)}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

.home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:80px;height:4px;background:rgba(255,80,120,0.2);border-radius:999px;z-index:5}

/* 模态弹窗 */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:150;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.modal.show{display:flex;animation:modalFade .25s}
@keyframes modalFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.modal-card{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#2a0a1a,#1a0510);border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;color:#ffccdd;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(255,30,80,0.3);max-width:240px;width:100%}
.modal-title{font-size:12px;color:#ff99bb;letter-spacing:2px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.modal-content{font-size:9px;line-height:1.6;color:#ddccdd;text-align:left;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px;white-space:pre-wrap;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.modal-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.modal-btns button{flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:12px;font-size:9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700}
.modal-btns .primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff1755,#ff5588);color:#fff;border:none}
.modal-btns .secondary{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);color:#ff99bb}

/* 抽卡弹窗 */
.draw-modal-card{background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#2a0a1a,#0a0205);border:2px solid #ffd700;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,.4)}
.draw-result{text-align:center;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.draw-rare-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:6px}
.draw-rare-tag.N{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#888,#aaa);color:#fff}
.draw-rare-tag.R{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#6366f1);color:#fff}
.draw-rare-tag.SR{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a855f7,#c084fc);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(168,85,247,.6)}
.draw-rare-tag.SSR{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ff6b00);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,.7);animation:ssrShine 1s infinite}
@keyframes ssrShine{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,.7)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,215,0,1)}}
.draw-card-ic{font-size:42px;margin:6px 0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,.6));animation:drawFloat 2s infinite ease-in-out}
@keyframes drawFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
.draw-card-nm{font-size:14px;color:#ffd700;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}
.draw-card-ds{font-size:8px;color:#aa8899;margin-top:4px}

/* 契约书 */
.contract-card{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#fdf6e8,#e8d5b7);color:#3d2b1f;padding:14px;border-radius:8px;font-family:serif;position:relative;border:1px double #8b6332}
.contract-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:4px;border:1px solid rgba(139,99,50,.3);border-radius:5px;pointer-events:none}
.contract-tt{text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:#5c3a1f;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:3px;position:relative}
.contract-body{font-size:9px;line-height:1.8;color:#3d2b1f;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.contract-sign{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px dashed #8b6332;padding-top:8px;font-size:8px;color:#5c3a1f}
.contract-stamp{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:50px;width:50px;height:50px;border:2px solid #c41e3a;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#c41e3a;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;transform:rotate(-15deg);letter-spacing:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}

/* 关系档案 */
.relation-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,30,80,0.1),rgba(60,10,30,0.4));border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.3);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;color:#ffccdd}
.relation-hd{text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.relation-cp{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#ff99bb;margin-bottom:4px}
.relation-days{font-size:8px;color:#aa6677}
.relation-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.rs-item{text-align:center;padding:8px;background:rgba(255,30,80,0.05);border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,80,120,0.1)}
.rs-num{font-size:14px;color:#ff99bb;font-weight:700}
.rs-lb{font-size:7px;color:#996677;margin-top:1px}

/* 倒计时挑战 */
.timer-display{text-align:center;padding:16px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,30,80,0.1),transparent);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.timer-num{font-size:32px;color:#ff99bb;font-weight:700;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,30,80,0.6);letter-spacing:4px}

function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(s){return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>')}
function showToast(msg){var t=$('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show')},1800)}
function vibrate(ms){if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(ms||30)}
function rand(arr){return arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)]}
function rnum(min,max){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min}

function spawnFx(emoji,x,y){
  var dv=document.querySelector('.dv');
  var rect=dv.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(var i=0;i<5;i++){
    var p=document.createElement('div');
    p.className='fx-particle';
    p.textContent=emoji;
    p.style.left=(x-rect.left+rnum(-25,25))+'px';
    p.style.top=(y-rect.top+rnum(-15,15))+'px';
    p.style.animationDelay=(i*0.08)+'s';
    dv.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(function(el){el.remove()},1500,p);
  }
}

function getLevel(){var r=LEVELS[0];for(var i=0;i<LEVELS.length;i++){if(exp>=LEVELS[i].min)r=LEVELS[i]}return r}
function getLevelStars(lv){return '⭐'.repeat(lv||1)}
function getRareColor(r){return r||'N'}

function getAllPlays(){var all=[];CATS.forEach(function(c){(PLAYS[c.id]||[]).forEach(function(it){all.push({cat:c,item:it})})});customPlays.forEach(function(it){all.push({cat:{id:'custom',name:'自定义',icon:'✏️'},item:it})});return all}
function getPlayCount(){var cnt=0;CATS.forEach(function(c){cnt+=(PLAYS[c.id]||[]).length});return cnt+customPlays.length}
function isFav(name){return favList.indexOf(name)>-1}
function toggleFav(name){var idx=favList.indexOf(name);if(idx>-1)favList.splice(idx,1);else favList.push(name);try{localStorage.setItem('tj_favs',JSON.stringify(favList))}catch(e){}}

function updateStatusBar(){

  $('obeyBar').style.width=Math.min(100,obey)+'%';
  $('obeyNum').textContent=obey;
  $('shameBar').style.width=Math.min(100,shame)+'%';

}

function addStatus(l,o,s,e){
  lust=Math.min(100,lust+l);
  obey=Math.min(100,obey+o);
  shame=Math.min(100,shame+s);
  exp+=e;
  updateStatusBar();
  saveStatus();
}

function bindListEvents(){
  var s=$('listScr');
  s.querySelectorAll('.cd').forEach(function(cd){
    cd.onclick=function(e){
      var btn=e.target.closest('.cd-btn');
      var varOpt=e.target.closest('.variant-opt');
      if(varOpt){cd.querySelectorAll('.variant-opt').forEach(function(v){v.classList.remove('on')});varOpt.classList.add('on');curVariant=varOpt.dataset.vid;return}
      if(btn){
        var t=btn.dataset.t;var name=cd.dataset.name;var catId=cd.dataset.cat;
        var itm=null;
        if(catId==='custom')itm=customPlays.find(function(x){return x.name===name});
        else CATS.forEach(function(c){(PLAYS[c.id]||[]).forEach(function(it){if(it.name===name)itm=it})});
        if(!itm)return;
        if(t==='fav'){
          toggleFav(name);
          btn.textContent=isFav(name)?'💛已藏':'🤍收藏';
          if(isFav(name)&&!taskDone.fav1){taskDone.fav1=true;addStatus(0,0,0,8);showToast('任务完成 +8EXP')}else{showToast(isFav(name)?'已收藏':'已取消')}
          vibrate(20);return
        }
        if(t==='detail'){
          var cat=CATS.find(function(c){return c.id===catId})||{id:'custom',name:'自定义',icon:'✏️'};
          curDetail=itm;showPage('detail');renderDetail(cat,itm);return;
        }
        if(t==='c'||t==='u'){
          var txt=(t==='c'&&itm.tc)?itm.tc:(t==='u'&&itm.tu?itm.tu:null);
          if(!txt)return;
          var variantInfo='';
          if(curVariant&&itm.variants){var v=itm.variants.find(function(x){return x.id===curVariant});if(v)variantInfo='\n强度: '+v.name}
          var full=buildSendText(itm,t,variantInfo);
          try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:full},'*')}catch(e){}
          btn.textContent='✓已发';btn.classList.add('dn');vibrate(30);
          // 状态加分
          var lvAdd=(itm.level||1)*3;
          addStatus(lvAdd,lvAdd-1,lvAdd-2,(itm.level||1)*5);
          // 任务
          if(!taskDone.play1){taskDone.play1=true;addStatus(0,0,0,5);showToast('🎉 任务完成 +5EXP')}
          if(itm.fx){var rect=btn.getBoundingClientRect();spawnFx(itm.fx,rect.left,rect.top)}
          setTimeout(function(){btn.textContent=(t==='c'?'📤对Char':'📤对User');btn.classList.remove('dn')},2500);
          return
        }
      }
      var bd=cd.querySelector('.cd-bd');if(bd)bd.classList.toggle('on')
    }
  })
}

$('contractClose').onclick=function(){$('contractModal').classList.remove('show')};
$('contractSend').onclick=function(){
  var content=$('contractBody').textContent;
  try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（📜 我们签署了调教契约：\n\n'+content+'\n\n签署完毕。）'},'*')}catch(e){}
  $('contractModal').classList.remove('show');
  showToast('契约已签署 💕');
};

// 倒计时
var timerInterval=null,timerSec=1800,timerRunning=false;
function updateTimerDisplay(){
  var m=Math.floor(timerSec/60),s=timerSec%60;
  $('timerNum').textContent=String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(s).padStart(2,'0');
}
$('timerStart').onclick=function(){
  if(timerRunning){
    clearInterval(timerInterval);timerRunning=false;
    $('timerLb').textContent='已暂停';
    this.textContent='继续';
  }else{
    timerRunning=true;
    $('timerLb').textContent='挑战中...';
    this.textContent='暂停';
    timerInterval=setInterval(function(){
      timerSec--;
      updateTimerDisplay();
      if(timerSec<=0){
        clearInterval(timerInterval);
        timerRunning=false;
        $('timerLb').textContent='挑战完成！';
        vibrate([200,100,200]);
        try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（⏱️ 倒计时挑战完成！）'},'*')}catch(e){}
      }
    },1000);
  }
};
$('timerStop').onclick=function(){
  clearInterval(timerInterval);timerRunning=false;timerSec=1800;
  updateTimerDisplay();
  $('timerModal').classList.remove('show');
  $('timerStart').textContent='开始/暂停';
};

// 年龄验证
$('ageYes').onclick=function(){
  $('ageGate').classList.add('hidden');
  $('dvContent').classList.add('show');
  $('tm').textContent=String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
  vibrate(50);
  updateStatusBar();
  renderHome();
};
$('ageNo').onclick=function(){$('ageGate').innerHTML='<div style="color:#553344;font-size:11px">已退出 👋</div>'};

})();
</script>
</body>

.rm-wallet-ticket{
  position:relative;

  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#18233a 0%,#2a4c80 55%,#101827 100%);

}

.rm-wallet-ticket::before{
  content:"";

  height:18px;
  background:#f5f5f5;

}



.rm-wallet-ticket::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:50%;
  right:-9px;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  background:#f5f5f5;
  border-radius:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);
}

.rm-wallet-top{

.rm-wallet-route{

.rm-wallet-city{

.rm-wallet-path{

.rm-wallet-line{

.rm-wallet-line::before,

.rm-wallet-footer{

        <div class="qq-meta-item"><span class="m-l">📍 地点</span><span class="m-v">{{1.location}}</span></div>

function closeAll(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.app-window').forEach(function(w){w.classList.remove('open');});

document.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',closeAll);});

    document.querySelectorAll('.mt-page').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });

});

==== 真实性原则（重要）====
本模板的歌曲卡片支持点击跳转网易云搜索（URL: https://music.163.com/#/search/m/?s=歌名+歌手），用户点击会跳到真实搜索页。所以：

【优先级】真实存在的歌曲 > 编造的歌曲
1. **首选**：从你知识库里挑一首真实存在、且符合当前情绪/场景的歌（华语/日语/英语/韩语均可），用真实歌名+真实歌手。这样用户点击跳转后能搜到真实结果。
2. **次选**：如果有可用的「Tavily 网络搜索 MCP」工具，且用户对推荐准确性有要求（如"帮我找一首XX风格的真实存在的歌"），可调用 Tavily 搜索关键词如"XX风格 推荐歌曲 网易云"或"XX歌手 代表作"，从结果里选一首。
3. **末选**：纯氛围场景（如"给我编个氛围卡片"），允许虚构歌名歌手，但要注意虚构时不要用太奇怪的名字，否则跳转后用户搜不到会很出戏。

【歌词字段】lyric 字段：
- 真实歌曲 → 用该歌真实歌词中最戳心的一句（请准确，不要瞎编歌词）
- 不确定歌词 → 写"歌词留白" 或写一句符合歌曲情绪的原创短句，不要冒充真实歌词

==== CRITICAL FORMAT RULES ====
1. 整个 <网易云>...</网易云> 块必须在一行内。
2. 内部 JSON 完全压缩（无空格无换行无缩进）。
3. 字符串内换行用 \n，禁止真实换行。
4. 不要拆段、不要包代码块、不要 markdown。
5. 以 <网易云> 开头，</网易云> 结尾。
6. 所有字段必须填写齐全，不允许 {{1.xxx}} 占位符残留。
7. song 和 artist 字段会被拼到 URL 里，所以**不要带特殊字符**（如 ? & # / \），如有去掉。

==== 字段清单（全部必填） ====
song（歌名）, artist（歌手）, album（专辑名）, covDesc（封面文字描述20字内）, time（当前时间）, covMood（暖/冷/粉/暗/绿/橙）, duration（如 "03:45"）, progress（如 "01:24"）, lyric（戳心歌词一句）, likes（点赞数）, comments（评论数）, battery（20-99整数）, comment1Name~comment5Name, comment1Text~comment5Text, comment1Likes~comment5Likes

==== 字段规则 ====
· covMood 根据歌曲氛围选：温暖民谣→暖、电子冷调→冷、少女心→粉、丧/夜曲→暗、清新→绿、热烈→橙

· 5条评论走网易云乐评味：催泪/共情/故事性强/10-30字

aiPrompt:
当你触发关键词后想给user分享视频/刷抖音时，直接输出抖音模板，不要先用自然语言回应。
==== 模板核心结构 ====
模拟"沉浸式刷抖音"：3条视频上下滑动 + 顶部4个全局热榜TOP胶囊条 + 每条视频底部2个"相关热榜"。
所有热榜词条点击会智能跳转：手机端优先唤起抖音App，失败则跳网页版搜索。

==== 热榜字段两套数据，不要混淆！====

【全局TOP热榜】(顶部胶囊条，4个，固定按热度1-4排序)
  字段：top1, top2, top3, top4
  热度：top热度1, top热度2, top热度3, top热度4
  数据来源：**必须来自抖音热榜MCP工具返回的前4条**，按热度从高到低排列。
  这是"今天抖音最火的4条热点"，跟视频内容无关，是全局展示。

【视频相关热榜】(底部相关热榜区，每个视频2条，共6条)
  字段：相关1a, 相关1b（视频1底部），相关2a, 相关2b（视频2底部），相关3a, 相关3b（视频3底部）
  热度：相关热度1a, 相关热度1b, 相关热度2a, 相关热度2b, 相关热度3a, 相关热度3b
  数据来源：根据每条视频的话题/氛围，**从MCP返回的完整热榜列表中挑选语义相关的词条**，或者从top4之后的热榜里找。
  如果找不到强相关的，就自己编1-2个与视频氛围匹配的热榜词（标注合理热度即可）。
  禁止与top1~top4重复！

==== MCP 调用规则 ====
【真实模式】用户说"刷抖音/最近热门/dy热榜/最近什么火/给我看几条"等：
  必须先调用「抖音热榜MCP工具」，取返回数据：
    - 前4条按顺序填入 top1~top4 + top热度1~4
    - 从第5条之后或全部热榜里，按"语义相关性"为每条视频挑2个匹配的填入 相关1a~相关3b
  3条视频的 caption/videoDesc/topic 要围绕热榜话题来编，做到视频与热榜联动。

【编造模式】用户只说"分享个视频"等单视频场景：
  允许不调用MCP，自己编4个合理的TOP热榜+6个相关热榜，视频内容自由发挥。
  但**编造时也要保证top1~top4按热度递减排列**，相关热榜跟视频内容呼应。

==== CRITICAL FORMAT RULES ====
1. 整个 <抖音>...</抖音> 块必须在一行内。
2. 内部 JSON 完全压缩（无空格无换行无缩进）。
3. 字符串内换行用 \n，禁止真实换行。
